scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:metric && pnpm run test:server
scripts.lint: echo "Use lint:web for frontend lint checks"
scripts.lint:web: node apps/server/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js -c eslint.config.mjs apps/web-client/src packages/ui-react/src packages/ui-core/src packages/types/src --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.jsx,.mjs,.cjs
scripts.typecheck:web: pnpm --filter @seedar/web-client exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @seedar/ui-core run type-check && pnpm --filter @seedar/types run type-check
